description: This file defines React components for client-side navigation within a documentation system, including a navigation item component and a navigation container that renders navigation groups and items based on a provided navigation map.

methods.name: KeystaticNavItem
methods.description: A React component that renders a single navigation item, including a label and optional status badge.

methods.name: DocsNavigationClient
methods.description: A React component that renders a navigation menu based on the provided navigation map, grouping items into sections.
